sentences.en: The cost of financing of the project was very high.
sentences.zh: 这个项目的融资成本非常高。

sentences.en: The present state of the city's finances is not good.
sentences.zh: 这座城市目前的财政状况不佳。

sentences.en: One should always be careful in talking about one's finances.
sentences.zh: 在谈论自己的财务时，人们总是要小心谨慎的。
